call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one complete independent flat launch poster, portrait 4:5.

Create a photographic launch poster for the fictional FOLN folding cup. The content idea is the reversible difference between its usable volume and its compact storage volume. Show two states of ONE consistent cup design in one coherent studio photograph, not a diptych or comparison panels. No reference images are supplied.

Subject and mechanical consistency: A handleless 350 mL cup with a dark forest-green matte silicone body and a translucent milky-white lid. Show the expanded cup at left and the fully collapsed storage state at right, at the SAME photographic scale and camera perspective. Both versions have matching diameter, rim, rigid circular base, lid shape, color and a recognizable continuous accordion-wall architecture. The expanded body has a few broad tapered accordion fold sections; in the collapsed state those very same sections nest down into a compact shallow stack beneath the same circular translucent-white lid. Give both cups blank unmarked product surfaces, with no lettering, logos, labels or embossed marks. Both lids are seated plausibly on their rims and are visibly translucent rather than solid opaque white. Do not add a handle, loop, separate strap or other accessory.

Scene and photography: A continuous light warm-gray studio floor and backdrop, unobtrusive seamless horizon. Real-photograph-like product imagery with natural matte silicone texture, fine molding edges, convincing soft directional studio light from upper left, consistent contact shadows grounding both cups, restrained realistic reflections on the frosted lids. Three-quarter front camera, enough elevation to see both lids. The tall cup and shallow cup stand on one shared ground plane and their silhouettes and nesting walls remain fully visible. No hands, people, props, floating objects or decorative effects.

Composition and type relationship: Build the layout around the paired volume states. A substantial wide, dark-green sans-serif product name sits across the upper field and reads as one unit; compact FOLN identity belongs to this title group. The Korean action phrase spans the gap between the tall and compact silhouettes, tying the two states together. Keep the photo pair prominent through the middle of the poster with sufficient separation to see the volume difference. Set the specification close enough to the action phrase that it explains the same product. Give the launch date, preorder window and store URL a clearly readable, generously spaced group on the lower field. Concrete optical alignment, stable margins, clean baselines and strong contrast. Let product height and compactness determine the asymmetry; avoid a generic centered luxury heading. No framed panels, labels for states, arrows, invented linework, badges or unnecessary texture. The finest required type must remain readable in a 720-pixel-wide screen view. Do not squeeze information into tiny footer text or let any cup cover text.

Exact display copy: Render each of the following seven items once and only once. Preserve all letters, Korean characters, spaces, punctuation, dot separator, slash, numbers and dates. Natural grouping and line breaks at word boundaries are allowed; the list below is an inventory, not a mandated layout order. Do not print quotation marks, bullets or item numbers:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

These seven items are the only printable text. Fictional FOLN is plain display typography, not a new emblem or an imitation of an existing brand. No actual brands, product-surface letters, watermarks, extra slogans, fake microtext, measurement claims, model codes or graphic marks. Korean strokes and inter-word spaces must be correct and distinct. Render the preorder date separator as the supplied en dash.

Output a single finished flat image with all typography and photography integrated. Maintain exact portrait 4:5 ratio, with no border, mockup, frame or contact sheet. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
